note: Hotel porters, bellhops, maids, waitresses, cleaners, night watchmen, bank tellers.

lines.text: Good evening. Can I help you?
Evening, sir. Ma'am.
Double shift. Feet's on fire.
Convention in the ballroom. Thousand guests, ten tips.
They're cutting staff. Again. Last in, first out.
Somebody stole the towels from fourteen. All of them.
Umbrellas by the door. Take one, bring it back.
Laundry room's a hundred and twenty.
Oh! Pardon me, sir.
Sir! No running in the lobby!
Elevators out! Stairs only, folks! Stairs only!
Night shift. Just me and the radiator.
Thirty years. I know every guest by their shoes.
Next window, please.
Building's quiet at night. Too quiet. I sing.
Morning, Mr. Regular. The usual? You don't have a usual.
You carried my bags up four floors. Shine's free today.
Not you. Not in here. I'll call the manager.
Line's back there. Like everybody else.
Take the register! Take it! I'm just the help!
No problem. Have a nice day. I mean it, mostly.
Sorry. Right. Next customer, please.
